description: Sistema I+D — Laboratorio I+D · Gestión de Calidad

scripts.check: node -e "const{execSync}=require('child_process');const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');function w(d){return fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>e.isDirectory()?w(path.join(d,e.name)):e.name.endsWith('.js')?[path.join(d,e.name)]:[])}for(const f of [...w('js'),'sw.js','data/disenos-reales.js']){execSync('node --check '+JSON.stringify(f));}console.log('OK: sintaxis correcta')"
